_readme: THE HOUSE IDENTITY: the four facts every browser extension this repository ships shares, written once. A tool's publish/identity.json is these values with its own slug put in, and extensions/scripts/new-tool.mjs writes it that way at stamp time, together with the Firefox add-on id <slug>@<ownerDomain> in the stamped publish/manifest.firefox.json.

Graded by tooling/ci/assert-house-identity.mjs, in extensions-ci.yml's catalogue job: (a) no value here is a placeholder, (b) every extensions/Extension/*/publish/identity.json equals these values with {slug} expanded and its slug equal to its tool.json id, (d) a run that read no tool's identity is COVERAGE LOST, exit 2. Limb (c), the support address against tooling/legal/policy-claims.json, is not implemented: that file declares no support-address key to compare against (its top-level keys, measured 2026-09-25: _readme, pages, siteRoot, claims).

Every value below was FullShot's (extensions/Extension/Full_Screen_Shot/publish/identity.json) on the day this file was written. No new value was chosen here; the file moved them to where the next tool reads them.

⏱ 2026-10-01: THIS FILE IS ALSO THE ENTITY SOURCE. `entity` and `people` hold every business fact a product prints (owner lock: one edit to one source, then `node tooling/entity/render.mjs`); their own `entity._readme` says where the values come from (the brain's business/public-facts.json, compared by tooling/scripts/assert-business-facts.mjs) and what reads them. The four extension facts above are unchanged by that.

ownerDomain.why: The right-hand side of every Firefox add-on id, <slug>@<ownerDomain>. AMO fixes an add-on's id at FIRST SIGNING, so a placeholder that ships once is a permanently wrong identity rather than a typo. A domain this business controls: it serves the storefront the extensions are catalogued on. FullShot's identity.json records the choice as made on 2026-08-18.

supportEmail.why: The store listing's support field, one inbox for every tool. The same address is asserted in SECURITY.md and sites/nikatru/contact.html by the storefront's assert-repo-posture guard, so it is not a new claim.

privacyPolicyUrlPattern.why: One privacy page per tool, at a path named by the tool's slug. {slug} is replaced with the tool's slug to give its identity.json privacyPolicyUrl. The pattern states where the page will be; that a given tool's page is live is a separate fact, checked before a listing is submitted (FullShot's was verified live on 2026-08-21).

homepageUrl.why: The storefront that lists every extension. Optional in a store listing, and the same for every tool.

mail._why: PIPELINE identity, not a legal fact: the From of each Worker mail stream (tooling/ports/mail.json `streams`). Rendered into services/platform/src/generated/entity.ts by tooling/ports/render-entity.mjs, the only place Worker code reads an address from. Every sender is on mail.nikatru.com, the subdomain the Resend account has verified ([ADR 029] §2; trap auth-06: a send from the bare domain is refused 550). The values are the ones the code carried as literals until port-mail moved them here; none was chosen anew.

reports.why: [ADR 029] §2: owner alerts are `alerts@` on the pooled machine-mail subdomain. The support notice that a content report arrived (services/platform/src/lib/report-notify.ts); was REPORT_NOTICE_FROM.

reminders.why: [ADR 029] §2: a reminder to a USER is a different type of mail from an owner alert, so it has its own local-part and display name (services/platform/src/lib/reminders.ts); was REMINDER_FROM.

_readme: THE ENTITY SOURCE: every business fact a product prints, written once. A change of legal entity (a sole proprietorship becoming a Pvt Ltd, a new legal name, a new proprietor) is an edit HERE, then `node tooling/entity/render.mjs`, and nothing else in the tree is typed by hand. Owner lock, 2026-10-01: "Everything whichever applicable it should come from pipeline - always lock."

WHERE THE VALUES COME FROM. The business source of record is the brain (nikatru/business/public-facts.json). Every leaf here carrying a `brain` path is a COPY of that field, compared on every commit by tooling/scripts/assert-business-facts.mjs (hook-run: CI cannot read the brain) and refreshed by `node tooling/scripts/assert-business-facts.mjs --sync`. A leaf with no `brain` path is a pipeline decision recorded here and nowhere else; its `why` says so.

WHAT READS IT. tooling/entity/facts.mjs is the one loader. The FACT regions, the anchored fields and the generated files it renders are declared in tooling/entity/surfaces.json; tooling/sites/chrome.mjs renders the site footer from it; tooling/ports/render-entity.mjs renders the Worker module. assert-business-facts.mjs refuses a literal of any guarded fact anywhere else in the tree.

NEVER HERE: a PAN, a GSTIN, a residential address, or an officer's personal details. The slots exist (`registrations.gstin`, `officers`) so a future entity has somewhere to point; their values stay in Private platform-state/identity.json and the brain (ADR 034), and nothing renders them.

wording._why: The words a page uses for the form, so no page types them. A different form re-words all four here, and `node tooling/kit/entity-change.mjs --dry-run` lists every FACT region and field that prints one.

legalName.why: For a sole proprietorship the legal name IS the proprietor's name; a company's is its registered name.

tradeName.why: The registered trade name. The brand survives an entity change.

gstin.why: ADR 034: never on a public surface. The slot exists so a second state registration has a place to be listed by the dry run; the value is never written here.

cin.why: A private or public limited company's Corporate Identity Number. None today.

llpin.why: An LLP's identification number. None today.

registeredOffice._why: The registered office (brain public-facts `publicAddress`), published by owner ruling 2026-09-09. Read the field-rendering trap in the brain's vendors/awfis.md before changing how it renders.

contacts._why: The support inbox is `supportEmail` at the top of this file: a DOMAIN fact (it moves only with the domain, which an entity change leaves alone), held by assert-house-identity and assert-repo-posture, and compared with the brain by assert-business-facts.

grievanceOfficer.title: Proprietor
grievanceOfficer.why: The grievance officer the contact and support pages name. A company names an officer instead; until the owner records one, `title` and the person stay the proprietor.

legal.why: Unset: support@ answers legal mail today.

privacy.why: Unset: support@ answers privacy mail today.

law.why: terms.html §10, the governing law. No brain field records it.

courts.why: terms.html §10, the courts named. Follows the registered office's city today; recorded separately because a company may choose otherwise.

sellerOfRecord._why: Who sells, per payment rail (brain public-facts `sellerByRail`). Port rows cite these paths instead of typing a seller.

paddle.appliesTo: every non-India web sale, desktop, Microsoft Store, Snap, APK sideload, and browser-extension buyers outside India

razorpay.value: NIKATRU (Rajasekar Selvam, sole proprietor); Razorpay is only the payment gateway, and NIKATRU issues the GST invoice
razorpay.appliesTo: India purchases on nikatru.com, the apps.gov.in build, and India buyers of the three browser extensions

appleIap.appliesTo: in-app purchases on iPhone and Mac

playBilling.appliesTo: in-app purchases on Android through Google Play

storeSellerName.why: The developer or seller name a store prints (apps.gov.in "Developed By"). Today the brand; an Organization account on Apple prints the legal entity name instead, which the dry run lists.

storeAccounts._why: The account type each store holds (brain public-facts `accountTypeByStore`). Rendered into tooling/channel-register.json `accountStatus.accountType` for each channel named here.

officers.why: Directors, partners or the proprietor as signatories. Never rendered; the dry run lists them as who signs.

holder.why: The holder the site and app copyright lines name today.

firstYear.why: The first year is fixed; the last is the build year (tooling/entity/facts.mjs `copyrightYears`).

established.why: The year the business was established, printed as "established in 2021" on both sites since launch and as nikatru.com's JSON-LD foundingDate. Moved here on 2026-10-02 so sites/rajasekarselvam renders it (FACT msme-established, and an anchored field in its llms.txt) instead of typing it. No brain field records it yet: OWNER confirms it against the Udyam certificate and gives it a `brain` path.

gstStatus.value: Registered under GST since 15 July 2026; the GSTIN is deliberately not in this file
gstStatus.why: Read by the dry run only; not rendered.

people._why: The PERSON behind the products, distinct from the entity: an entity change leaves the founder standing. For a sole proprietorship the two names are equal, and assert-business-facts holds that equality while the form is sole-proprietorship.

sameAs.why: The person's OWN public profiles (GitHub, LinkedIn, X …), rendered into his site's JSON-LD `sameAs` by tooling/sites/generate-personal-site.mjs. Empty until the owner names them: `globalonlinedeveloper` is the organisation that holds the code (tooling/github-org.json), not a personal profile. Never the company's site: sameAs asserts identity, and the person-company relation is worksFor/founder.

careerStartYear.why: The year the founder's professional career began, from which an "N+ years" line would be DERIVED, never typed. Unrecorded: the "11+ years" the personal site printed had no source, so it was removed on 2026-10-02 and waits on the owner.
